Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Suresh - 29 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Hema - 64 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Suresh stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Suresh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Suresh pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Hema: "Well done!"

[Suresh sips red wine.]

Suresh: "Well done!"

[Suresh drinks a beer.]

Suresh: "What next?"

[Suresh and Mother clink their glasses.]

Suresh: "What next?"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Suresh stands on the road. Hema stands near him.]

Suresh: "What a nice place."

[Suresh starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Suresh: "Mom, look at this."

[Suresh is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Hema: "Show me too!"

[Suresh steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Suresh: "One more time!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

Suresh: "Mom, look over here."

[Suresh rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Suresh: "Show me too!"

[Suresh takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Suresh: "I really enjoyed today."
